channel.title: South Africa - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Africa, every source cited.

item.title: Ex-Idac head Johnson and ex-Crime Intelligence Khan granted bail
item.description: The Pretoria Magistrate’s Court granted bail to Andrea Johnson and Feroz Khan on charges of defeating the ends of justice.

item.title: South Africa minister condemns brutal farm attack
item.description: Cattle farmer Donovan Marx was shot, stabbed, and had both ears cut off on his farm near Potchefstroom.

item.title: South Africa cuts fuel prices ahead of elections
item.description: Diesel prices to fall by over R1.60 per litre and petrol by up to 49c/l due to government levy reductions.

item.title: Airports company focuses on passenger dignity
item.description: Airports Company South Africa acknowledges challenges faced by neurodivergent travellers.

item.title: Cape Town urges low-income residents to apply for rates relief
item.description: City of Cape Town encourages households earning under R7 500 monthly to seek assistance with municipal bills.
